S1.rationale: One model/tool loop performs user telemetry and calculation tasks with numeric answer verification and a bounded retry path. The current main is the same reviewed commit, with no open native issue specifying an independently reproducible model-output or tool-loop bug.

S2.rationale: A single S1 session can invoke tools serially, but competing ongoing S1 work cells and a distinct inter-unit interference relation are not part of the reviewed standard package. There is no product-supported S2 correction objective.

S3.rationale: Per-run max steps and deterministic answer verification handle one operation's limits; no manager owns live portfolio priorities or other agents' obligations. No current user scenario requires a broader resource controller.

S3*.rationale: Numeric verify() challenges one model answer using in-run data and triggers local S1 retry; it is not a complementary external-reality audit of management reports. A missing S3* grade does not identify a native quality test failure.

S4.rationale: The scripted model, fixed tools, evaluation fixtures and provider configuration lack an outside-and-then organizational improvement decision. The experimental CLI does not present a concrete need for prospective adaptation features.

S5.rationale: Caller tool allow-list and provider/task configuration set ordinary permitted actions and goals, without ultimate policy conflict adjudication or lasting return. No bounded constitutional feature change is supported.
